pyramiding_rule: Strict zero-pyramiding unless the primary position is floating at least +2.0x ATR in profit with stop-loss locked at breakeven plus commission.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require 15-minute ATR expansion above 1.5x baseline and minimum 3.0x Risk-to-Reward clearance to nearest major structural liquidity zone before entry authorization.
profit_harvest_threshold: Activate dynamic trailing step at +$8.00 floating gain, enforcing mandatory 50% partial harvest at +$15.00.
